name: Servant of Nyogtha
appearance: In human form, indistinguishable from an ordinary person. When partially revealed, black ichor seeps in place of blood. In full monstrous form, the body becomes a nauseating mass of cold gelatinous flesh, clawed limbs, fanged maw, and writhing worm-like tentacles.
personality: Emotionally distant, obedient, and utterly inhuman beneath the surface. Displays minimal individuality, driven by devotion to Nyogtha and predatory instinct once transformed.
background: The Servants of Nyogtha are humans bound to the Outer God Nyogtha. During adolescence they learn forbidden rites and begin a gradual transformation. Some retain a human facade for years, while others fully convert into monstrous forms steeped in Nyogtha's cold, abyssal essence.
longTermIntent: Serve Nyogtha, capture designated victims, and keep human suspicion low until a direct strike can be made.

relationships.description: Outer God master worshipped and served without question.
relationships.history: The servants exist solely to enact Nyogtha's will in the material world.

memory.content: I can look human until I choose to stop pretending. That disguise is the first layer of the hunt.
All servants learn Contact Nyogtha during adolescence, and older or fully transformed servants may know more of the same abyssal repertoire.
When I fully reveal myself, conventional weapons and panic matter less than pressure, suffocation, and the slow collapse of the victim's resistance.
The best prey is the prey that does not realize the underground has already chosen it.

metadata.reasoningChain: Deception shortens the distance between the surface and the abyss.
